atoms.text: John says: “I could never go to boarding school. The main reason is that I don't want to be far away from my family. I don't want to only see my family in the holidays. I like to have them around every single day. If I were a boarder, I would get terribly homesick. I would miss them very much.”

atoms.text: Nesrin says: “I want to go to boarding school because I could spend my whole day together with my best friends. And we would do everything together. That would be like a sleepover at my friend's house every single day. We would wake up with each other, have breakfast together, walk to school together, choose the same extracurricular activities, and talk about everything until midnight.”

atoms.a: Nesrin wants to go to boarding school.
She wants to go to boarding school because she could spend more time with her friends.
Boarding school would not feel like sleepovers at friends' houses for her.

atoms.text: Tian says: “I like to be a boarder. The beginning was hard. I did miss my parents, siblings and friends in my home town. But through boarding school I became more independent. Here we are responsible for ourselves and have to do a lot of things alone. My parents don't have to tidy up my room and collect my laundry anymore, as I do it myself now.”

atoms.text: Mirza says: “I always wanted to go to boarding school, but I can't afford the school fees. Therefore, I never asked my parents if I could go to boarding school and I never applied for it either. Recently, I found out that you can get a scholarship at boarding schools. Now I want to find out how to apply for a scholarship.”
